lines.text: [delighted] Mmm! Ellie... health to your hands!
[British accent] [alarmed] My hands?! [panicked] What's wrong with my hands?!
[warm, loud] Ellie kızım! Health to your hands!
[British accent] [dead serious] Nobody touches these hands.
[proudly] No problem. My English is perfect.
[playfully] Elinize sağlık demek istiyorsan: This is delicious! [pause] İkinci bölümde: Don't eat my head! Kaçırma!
